humanities_role_explanation: MILU is a general multi-subject knowledge benchmark (8 domains, 41 subjects) built from Indian competitive exams; Arts & Humanities is one domain among STEM, law, business etc. Humanities material supplies some items, but the competence tested is general multilingual knowledge MCQ, not disciplinary competence.
benchmark_modalities_explanation: Text-only multiple-choice questions in 11 languages; image-based questions were explicitly excluded.
analytical_tasks_explanation: Exam-style MCQs on India-specific knowledge (local history, arts, festivals, laws) and general subjects (science, logical reasoning); the paper describes them as assessing 'general problem-solving abilities and India-specific knowledge'.

general_purpose_benchmark.note: Broad multi-task, multi-domain benchmark: 8 domains, 41 subjects, 11 languages.

evaluates_generative_llm.note: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-Pro/Flash, Krutrim, Llama-3.x, Gemma-2, Aya-23, Sarvam, and many Indic fine-tuned models (42-45 LLMs).

quantitative_metrics.note: Accuracy (log-likelihood for open models, generative JSON for API models).

summary: MILU is an India-centric multi-task MCQ benchmark covering 8 domains, 41 subjects and 11 Indic languages, built from national and state-level competitive exams. The authors evaluate over 40 LLMs, finding GPT-4o best at ~74% and Indic language-specific models near random. Models do worse in culturally specific domains and low-resource languages.
key_findings: GPT-4o averages 74.74% accuracy; Gemini-1.5-Pro 67.72%; best open model Llama-3.1-70B 64.37%. Language-specific Indic models are near random (~25-40%). Performance is higher in high-resource languages (en, hi, bn) than low-resource ones. Models are weaker on Arts & Humanities, Social Sciences and Law & Governance than on STEM. Base models improve with few-shot examples while instruct models do not; scale helps significantly.
facets_explanation: Questions and answers were scraped from online portals hosting previously released exam papers; the paper says 'subject experts ensure the accuracy of the answers'. Questions require external knowledge (e.g., regional history, schemes). The Arts & Humanities domain content is described as 'highly dependent on regional culture', with region-specific questions in each state language. About 25% of questions were machine-translated from English with GPT-4o, and topic tags were partly generated by GPT-4o-mini.
results_explanation: GPT-4o has the highest 'avg' of 74.74 accuracy in Table 3 (zero-shot, generative evaluation). Zero-/1-/5-shot comparisons are reported for open models (Figure 3, per-subject tables) but no single largest gap is stated numerically in text, so the gap points are null. The paper states models perform better in 'en, hi, bn' than low-resource languages and worse in 'Arts & Humanities, Social Sciences, and Law & Governance' than STEM. No human baseline is reported.

humanities_role.quote: MILU is designed as a culturally relevant benchmark to assess general problem-solving abilities and India-specific knowledge.

dataset_size.quote: In total, we release around 79K questions across 41 subjects across 8 domains in 11 languages

primary_evaluation_setting.quote: All models, except for proprietary models and LLAMA-3.1-405B, are tested under 0-shot, 1-shot, and 5-shot setups.

gold_source.quote: These portals typically tag questions manually with topic names and language details, and subject experts ensure the accuracy of the answers.

gold_beyond_stimulus.quote: Under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Scheme, the finan- cial help provided to the small and marginal farmers is ___________ .

gold_community_dependent.quote: Its content varies significantly by lan- guage, as it is highly dependent on regional culture.

answer_multiplicity.quote: we select the answer string (ai) with the highest conditional log probability

reported_format_gap.quote: the performance of base models consistently improves with an increas- ing number of in-context examples, with the 5-shot setup yielding the best results.

reported_format_gap_kind.quote: Instruct models exhibit more varied behavior, where mod- els either stagnate or even degrade in performance.

reported_cultural_asymmetry.quote: Performance is notably higher in high-resource languages- en, hi, bn -as compared to the low-resource ones.
